english.title: Fail to report a traffic accident at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) after having been involved in a traffic accident at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) at Luton Airport resulting in personal injury to another person, or damage to another vehicle or to any other property constructed on, fixed to, growing in or otherwise forming part of the land on which the road in question was situated or land adjacent to such land, failed to report the details of the accident to an airport official or a constable immediately or as soon as practicable thereafter
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.10(b) and 7.1 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence only applies to a part of the airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) after having been involved in a traffic accident at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) at Luton Airport resulting in personal injury to another person, or damage to another vehicle or to any other property constructed on, fixed to, growing in or otherwise forming part of the land on which the road in question was situated or land adjacent to such land, the defendant failed to report the details of the accident to an airport official or a constable immediately or as soon as practicable thereafter.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
